name: Cheque Cancellation Or Stop Request V 02
definition: The ChequeCancellationOrStopRequest message is sent by a drawer bank, or a bank acting on behalf of the drawer bank, to the agent on which a cheque has been drawn (the drawee bank) to request for the cancellation of the presentment and/or stop the payment of the cheque referred to in the message.

GroupHeader.name: Group Header
GroupHeader.definition: Set of characteristics shared by all individual cheques included in the message.

Cheque.name: Cheque
Cheque.definition: Specifies the details of the cheque.

SupplementaryData.name: Supplementary Data
SupplementaryData.definition: Additional information that cannot be captured in the structured elements and/or any other specific block.
